title: Motion Designer (freelance) (Promova)
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 2 skills: tiktok, youtube. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview: At Promova , we're redefining language education for the AI-powered era - making learning accessible, personal, and inspiring for millions of people worldwide. Our 150+ teammates unite around one mission: to connect people, bridge cultures, and empower lifelong learners - in every country except aggressor states (yes, even Antarctica). We blend AI innovation with human creativity to help people speak with confidence and truly belong anywhere. If you want to test bold ideas, move fast, and make an impact - you'll feel right at home. About the Role We're looking for a Motion Designer (freelance or full-time) to create emotionally engaging, high-performing video ads that strengthen our marketing message, capture attention, and drive business results. In this role , you'll directly influence key performance metrics such as retention, CTR, CPA, and overall creative effectiveness. You'll get the freedom to experiment with bold, trend-led concepts and work with cutting-edge AI tools , including Claude integrations, creative agents, and more. What You'll Do You'll lead the creation of high-performing motion content that drives measurable growth across major paid channels. You'll test, iterate, and push Promova's creative capabilities forward - from production to AI-powered innovation. Produce video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other acquisition channels. Partner with the performance team on creative testing - translate performance data into design iterations that improve CTR, CPA, and conversion. Develop new creative concepts and scale what works into winning, testable hypotheses. Partner with creative marketing specialists to identify what resonates with our audience and why. Stay on top of creative trends across paid social and spot what's worth testing for our audience. Research and integrate AI tools to improve team workflows (AI animation, video generation, automation). What We're Looking For 1+ years of experience in motion design. Experience in creating performance marketing (paid Meta, TikTok and other ads) creatives. Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects . Solid knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, or Figma. Experience working with brand guidelines and adapting brand assets for different formats. Confident use of GPT, Midjourney, and AI video tools . Interested? Apply now and let's make the growth happen! Not your thing? Got a reco
